# About this Book {-}

This book is part of a series of books for the Genomic Data Science Analysis, Visualization, and Informatics Lab-space (AnVIL) of the National Human Genome Research Institute (NHGRI). Learn more about AnVIL by visiting https://anvilproject.org or reading the [article in Cell Genomics](https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S2666979X21001063).

## AnVIL Collection {-}

Please check out our full collection of AnVIL and related resources: https://hutchdatascience.org/AnVIL_Collection/

# Learning Objectives {-}

1. Provision GPU-accelerated cloud infrastructure on AnVIL and deploy local AI models within RStudio.
1. Explore gander, the RStudio AI assistant, to leverage context-aware data exploration and coding assistance.
1. Execute bioinformatics workflow through gander using plain-language AI prompts combined with tidyverse and DESeq2.
